sloka: वैरम् शत गुणम् पश्य मम तैः जीवित अंतकम् ।सुघोर हृदयैः सौम्य राक्षसैः काम रूपिभिः ॥३-६४-५१॥
transliteration: vairam śata guṇam paśya mama taiḥ jīvita aṁtakam ।sughora hṛdayaiḥ saumya rākṣasaiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ ॥3-64-51॥

translations.english: This indeed is the path the man or the demon has traversed. My enmity with him now has become hundredfold. This will end only with the extermination of his life.
